SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.ID LINKROWID --采购发票 ,S.DOCNUM --发票单号 ,S.DOCTYP --单据类型 ,DOCSTA.OPTDES DOCSTA ,DOCGRP.OPTDES DOCGRP ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.DOCDAT, 23) DOCDAT --单据日期 ,S.SITE --地点 ,SI.SITENAM SITEDES ,S.DEPT --申请部门 ,DE.DEPTNAM DEPTDES ,S.GRP --申请班组 ,GR.GRPNAM GRPDES ,S.RESNO --申请人 ,RE.RESNAM RESNODES ,S.BPSNO --商业伙伴（客户、供应商） ,BPS.BPSNAM ,S.DOCDES --单据描述 ,S.REMARK --备注 ,S.PRJNUM --项目编号 ,S.SRCTYP --来源类型 ,S.SRCDOC --来源单据 ,S.SRCLIN --来源行号 ,S.CLOREA --关闭原因 ,S.PRNCNT --打印次数 ,S.CREUSR --创建用户 ,S.UPDUSR --修改用户 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.CRETIM, 21) CRETIM ,IIF(CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) = '1900-01-01', '', CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21)) UPDTIM FROM PINVOICE S LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCGRP ON DOCGRP.OPTID = S.DOCGRP AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'PIV' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN ENTSITE SI ON SI.SITE = S.SITE LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS ON BPS.BPSNO = S.BPSNO LEFT JOIN ENTDEPT DE ON DE.DEPT = S.DEPT LEFT JOIN ENTGRP GR ON GR.GRP = S.GRP LEFT JOIN ENTRES RE ON RE.RESNO = S.RESNO WHERE S.DOCNUM + S.DOCDES + S.PRJNUM + S.DEPT + S.RESNO LIKE '%{0}%' AND S.DOCDAT BETWEEN '{1}' AND '{2}' AND S.DOCSTA LIKE '%{3}%' ORDER BY S.DOCNUM DESC
SysDataModelXML.SQLUpdateScript: --LINKADDNEWROWS --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS MERGE INTO [PREQAH] D USING ( SELECT N'@DOCNUM@' DOCNUM ,N'@DOCGRP@' DOCGRP ,N'1' DOCSTA ,N'SAVED' WFLSTA ,N'@DOCDAT@' DOCDAT ,N'@DOCDES@' DOCDES ,N'@PRJNUM@' PRJNUM ,N'@SITE@' SITE ,N'@DEPT@' DEPT ,N'@GRP@' GRP ,N'@RESNO@' RESNO ,N'@REMARK@' REMARK ,N'@CLOREA@' CLOREA , N'#LOGIN_USER#' CREUSR , GETDATE() CRETIM ) S ON (S.[DOCNUM] = D.[DOCNUM]) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM ,DOCGRP = S.DOCGRP ,DOCDAT = S.DOCDAT ,DOCDES = S.DOCDES ,PRJNUM = S.PRJNUM ,SITE = S.SITE ,DEPT = S.DEPT ,GRP = S.GRP ,RESNO = S.RESNO ,REMARK = S.REMARK ,CLOREA = S.CLOREA ,UPDUSR='#LOGIN_USER#' ,UPDTIM=GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DOCNUM ,DOCGRP ,DOCSTA ,WFLSTA ,DOCDAT ,DOCDES ,PRJNUM ,SITE ,DEPT ,GRP ,RESNO ,REMARK ,CLOREA ,CREUSR ,CRETIM ) VALUES ( S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCGRP ,S.DOCSTA ,S.WFLSTA ,S.DOCDAT ,S.DOCDES ,S.PRJNUM ,S.SITE ,S.DEPT ,S.GRP ,S.RESNO ,S.REMARK ,S.CLOREA ,S.CREUSR ,S.CRETIM );

SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM PREQAH WHERE DOCNUM='#DOCNUM#' AND DOCSTA='1';
